meta.name: pdf-text-replace
meta.description: Replace text in fillable PDF forms by updating form field values. This skill should be used when users need to update names, addresses, dates, or other text in PDF form fields.

copy.tagline: 更新可填写PDF表单中的文本字段
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要批量或自动更新PDF表单中的姓名、地址等字段
copy.tagline_en: Update text fields in fillable PDF forms
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to batch or automatically update names, addresses, etc. in PDF forms

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以替换可填写 PDF 表单中的字段文本，例如更新姓名、地址、日期等。它会扫描表单字段，找到包含指定文本的字段并替换为新文本，然后生成新的 PDF 文件。
howto.when: 当用户需要更新可填写 PDF 表单中的文本时触发，例如修改税表上的姓名、地址或日期。

say.text: 帮我替换这个 PDF 表单里的旧地址为新地址。
say.note: Claude 会扫描表单字段，替换地址并输出新文件。

say.text: 把税表上的姓名从“张三”改成“李四”。
say.note: Claude 会找到姓名所在字段并替换。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can replace text in fillable PDF forms by updating form field values, such as names, addresses, or dates. It scans all form fields, finds those containing the search text, replaces it, and creates a new PDF.
howto.when_en: Triggered when users need to update text in fillable PDF forms, e.g., modifying names, addresses, or dates in tax forms.

say_en.text: Replace the old address with the new one in this PDF form.
say_en.note: Claude will scan form fields, replace the address, and output a new file.

say_en.text: Change the name in the tax form from 'John Doe' to 'Jane Doe'.
say_en.note: Claude will find the name field and replace it.
